title: Mapping, filtering and reducing in Mini
description: You can follow values through three list operations.

steps.description: range(10) supplies nums. You pass a function that squares each n to map, producing squares.

steps.question: Does filter test the original numbers or their squares?
steps.answer: It tests squares, the list passed as its second argument. It keeps values whose remainder after division by two is zero.

steps.description: You see [0, 4, 16, 36, 64] printed. These are the squared values retained by the even-value test.
reduce starts with accumulator 0 and adds each value from range(1, 6). You see the total 15 printed.
